scope: All 19 ASPT lessons, all 91 terms, 24 focus questions, linked topic practice, figures/captions, coverage notes and five final-review groups.
rule: Keep every explicitly listed guide competency, term and figure label. Keep basic class explanation needed to learn it. Exclude advanced class extensions from focused ASPT practice; do not claim exclusions are guaranteed absent from the exam.
sourceReview: Read all 911 pages of the 13 supplied chapter PDFs as text; verified the relevant source passages for revised lesson points. Reused existing reviewed image assets without alteration.
